brief_item.title: Agent Retrieval Bench把代码上下文获取单独量化
brief_item.direction_name: 上下文定位、构建与裁剪
brief_item.core_conclusion: 论文将代码Agent的上下文获取从补丁生成中单独抽出，评估下一步文件，而非只看查询与文件的语义相似度。基准包含25个仓库的427个样本，记录检索命中、上下文预算和交互探索代价。
brief_item.mechanism: 覆盖code2test、comment2context、trace2code和edit2ripple，并加入无目标文件的自然与反事实样本。评测使用Recall@k、MRR、预算上下文收益和轨迹成本。
brief_item.result: 345个正样本中，Qwen3-Embedding-4B的样本加权MRR最高，8B的Recall@20最高，RepoMap的8K预算上下文收益最高。287条交互轨迹有27%至35%完全未触及金标准文件，混合检索结果随指标而变。
brief_item.boundary: 基准只评估文件级上下文获取，不评估补丁生成或测试通过率。仓库覆盖六种主要语言，文件内定位仍较粗，动态多轮检索和重复随机种子的因果效果尚未验证。
brief_item.project_relevance: 这项基准提示项目把Read、Grep轨迹和金标准文件触达率作为独立指标，并组合结构检索与语义检索。接入前应在本地仓库记录上下文预算、工具调用和后续修复结果。

facts.title: Agent Retrieval Bench: Evaluating Repository Context Retrieval for Coding Agents
facts.event_hint: Agent Retrieval Bench evaluates workflow-grounded file retrieval and context acquisition for coding agents
facts.problem: End-to-end patch scores hide an upstream failure surface: coding agents must identify the repository files needed next, often via indirect workflow signals, before editing. Static retrieval quality, context-budget survival, and interactive exploration can diverge.
facts.mechanism: The benchmark freezes repositories at pre-resolution base commits and defines agentic relevance as the next useful context, not query–file semantic similarity. It evaluates file-level ranking on code2test, comment2context, trace2code, and edit2ripple, plus natural and counterfactual no-gold abstention; metrics include Recall@k, MRR, budgeted context yield, trajectory cost, and a controlled context-seed pilot.

evidence.claim: Agent Retrieval Bench contains 427 samples across 25 repositories: 345 positive retrieval examples, 50 natural no-gold cases, and 32 counterfactual wrong-repository controls.
The combined corpus manifest contains 308 base-commit snapshots, about 392,000 files, and 7.9 million chunks; the released samples use 271 snapshots.
evidence.source_locator: PDF p.1 abstract; p.7 Dataset construction

evidence.claim: On 345 positive samples, Qwen3-Embedding-4B has the best sample-weighted MRR, Qwen3-Embedding-8B the best Recall@20, and RepoMap the best budgeted context yield at 8K; task-level winners differ.
evidence.value: different winners by MRR, Recall@20, and BCY@8K
evidence.baseline: other evaluated lexical, embedding, and structural retrievers
evidence.source_locator: PDF p.1 abstract; p.2 contribution summary

evidence.claim: Logged trajectories miss every gold file on 27–35% of samples, despite interactive exploration.

Selective thresholds that appear useful when counterfactual controls are mixed with natural cases do not improve selective success on the 50 natural no-gold cases after construction-controlled recalibration.
evidence.condition: repo-grouped natural-only protocol; 345 positives + 50 natural no-gold

facts.evaluation_context: The benchmark uses workflow-derived queries from real repositories frozen at base commits and evaluates file-level retrieval, token-budget packing, selective abstention, logged trajectories, and a 45-sample controlled seed intervention. It explicitly does not evaluate patch generation or test-passing repair.
facts.limitations: The benchmark is diagnostic rather than web-scale, with uneven repository frequencies and 25 repositories across six primary languages. File-level exposure is not exact within-file localization; 51.8% of sample–gold-file occurrences exceed 500 lines. Static leaderboards do not evaluate dynamic multi-turn retrieval, and the seed pilot has one trajectory per sample–arm pair without repeated random seeds. Gold labels are evidence-backed but may omit alternative useful files, and no causal ARB-to-patch-success link is established.
facts.project_relevance: The benchmark supports separating context acquisition from later coding outcomes and tracking both retrieval entry and agent-side gold-file contact. Its 27–35% miss rate and complementary structural/semantic winners suggest measuring Read/Grep trajectories and using hybrid retrieval rather than assuming one embedding or repository map dominates.
source_notes: The arXiv v1 PDF and all four referenced chunks were fetched; evidence locators refer to PDF pages and sections.
The paper explicitly warns that its metrics are context-acquisition diagnostics, not patch-success estimates.
